deferred_to_run.adjudicated_by: gate_run.run_cached_gate: the spatial_power record measured on the train partition, and the power_adjudication that refuses to report an inadequately powered absence as a negative finding
deferred_to_run.statement: Whether the frozen 161 px crop leaves enough uncontaminated interior to detect the effect it is looking for is a power question about a field that does not exist yet. The crop is unchanged, and it is now admitted by a derived requirement of 150 px at db2 level 3 rather than by the R13 128 px heuristic, but this record does not establish that 139 px of valid interior is sufficient and must not be read as doing so.

deferred_to_run.adjudicated_by: gate_run: spatial_power_refusal re-runs the resolution audit at the measured Theiler window, and an unresolvable partition is INVALID rather than FAIL
deferred_to_run.statement: The pre-acquisition audit uses the most favourable Theiler window of one frame, and the resolution_margin reason states a designed margin rather than a prediction. The window the sweep actually derives is not known until the series exists.

deferred_to_run.adjudicated_by: the two-stage acquisition order: canary overlap, then full cache overlap
deferred_to_run.statement: No data has been acquired for either campaign. The successor is a design, not a record, and the live regional ERA5 acquisition gate remains open.

preserved.statement: The superseded record spanned five whole calendar years. The successor spans six. The minimal repair would have spanned five years and 58 days, dropping a design property the defect being repaired had nothing to do with.

reasons.statement: The frozen design declared 36 tests under Benjamini-Yekutieli at alpha=0.05 and a confirmatory partition of 2,914 frames, which supplies 2,912 distinct admissible circular shifts against the 3,005 that family needs. Surrogates are drawn with replacement, so requesting 4,999 of them returned 4,999 numbers and a nominal floor of 1/5000 while the exact test could not reach the corrected level at any effect size. The design could not PASS, and no crop, ensemble size or analysis choice could rescue it -- only frames.

The minimal repair -- extending to 2023-02-27 for 3,007 confirmatory frames -- resolves only at a Theiler window of one frame, and the sweep sets that window from the measured temporal decorrelation of the series it is testing. A design with no margin against its own autocorrelation would have reproduced the same deficit after the transfer instead of before it. The successor carries 245 frames of margin against a declared floor of 16, which is four days at this cadence.
